package.name: ohm_ros2
package.description: Live OHM (CSIRO Occupancy Homogeneous Map) node for ROS 2 Humble. Subscribes to sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 + tf, integrates rays into a GPU occupancy map via ohm::GpuMap, publishes the occupied voxel cloud. Set use_ndt:=true to switch the internal mapper to ohm::GpuNdtMap.
